Karthik —

Appreciate the clear timeline. A few notes from procurement/legal side:
- Procurement prefers a vendor risk assessment (VRA) as part of the eval. Our security team will only accept a completed questionnaire + SOC 2 report before listing on our vendor portal.
- Legal (Paul) will want to review MSA redlines; we usually return consolidated redlines rather than line-by-line negotiations.
- Data residency: for PHI adjacency we need confirmation that customer data will remain in our US region and any sub-processing is disclosed.

Timeline constraints: our internal procurement committee meets 31 Aug. To make that cycle, we need the security questionnaire back by Aug 24 and at least a clean initial MSA + DPA redline set by Aug 28. If those slip, procurement won't be able to include the order in the Aug 31 packet; it will push to mid-September.

I’ve looped in Paul from legal to coordinate the redlines. Samir — can you confirm who on your side will complete the questionnaire?

Claire

Karthik / Marcus —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick take and recommended gating to keep this in the Aug window:

Security gating
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II report within 24 hours of request (redacted). I’ll prepare a one-page architecture/data-residency note confirming US region processing only and listing subprocessors.
- I recommend we complete the security questionnaire stub ourselves where possible and mark items for MedSys to confirm. That should shorten back-and-forth.

DPA/MSA sequencing
- Proposal: pre-execute DPA (standard Redwood template) + execute order form to lock pricing and enable provisioning. Keep MSA negotiations post-order with a defined two-week cleanup window. This is a common pattern and acceptable when the DPA covers data handling and liability floors.
- Concessions: we can accept a limited set of customer-friendly redlines (mutual indemnity limited to breach-caused damages, but decline open-ended audit frequency). I’ll prepare a consolidated redline set by Aug 27 for your review.

Operational asks
- SalesOps (Marcus) should record the committed pricing and term in HubSpot and create a pre-sign order form PDF for Claire to approve.
- If MedSys insists on an earlier procurement packet, we can provide a procurement pack (SOC2 + questionnaire + DPA draft) for Aug 24 review and indicate that MSA redlines will follow.

I’ll attach the SOC2 stub and the draft DPA in my next note. For now, assume we can meet the requested gating if Sales confirms the order form content today.

Irene Choi
